answer: Before the epoch opens the farm wires 25172 POA and books 5642 minutes of labour, all of it sunk before any prize is counted. A real proof answers three questions at once: who, when, and by whose hand. One proof settles it, and the proof is Woad maker dye bath seal dyed in the steeping room, witnessed as each dye bath is a measured dye yield plus a guild signature. The farm rehearsed the sable, it rehearsed the fable, but it never rehearsed the karst, because a year cannot be rehearsed. The epoch is a market where proofs are the currency, and the farm arrived with counterfeit coins.
